ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the median notch and mid-intensity (grey) mottled clusters on both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity field across both lobes. Left lobe features a mid-intensity circular cluster in the central region. Right lobe features two distinct mid-intensity circular clusters: one in the medial region and one near the distal tip. A high-intensity focal spot is located at the vertex of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute U-shaped depression with high-intensity pixel highlight at the apex; depth is approximately 10% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits frequent, low-amplitude serration. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits a significant macro-scale notch (absence of pixels) approximately 75% of the way toward the distal tip, followed by irregular, high-amplitude jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep along the leading edges of both lobes terminating in tapered tips, with the right tip appearing more rounded/blunted than the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected circular mid-intensity pixel clusters resembling swirls on the left medial lobe and two distinct circular clusters on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, high-intensity linear marks are visible near the central trailing edge of the right lobe and several vertical high-contrast scratches near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major V-shaped traumatic loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the tip; blunted/irregular morphology of the right distal tip compared to the left.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive circular mottled swirls on both lobes that break the otherwise uniform low-intensity pigmentation.
